verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover both halves of the story. Synthetic data generation is documented through Replicator labeled-data output and controllable custom SDG pipelines with randomized scenes. Reinforcement learning at scale is documented through Isaac Lab, a GPU-accelerated framework with Warp/CUDA-graphable environments, headless workstation-to-datacenter operation, and integration with RL libraries such as skrl, RLLib and rl_games. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of synthetic-data quality and RL training throughput at scale.
